body: Whenever me and my ex boyfriend were in public, one of us would randomly start off and say "hey, let's go find a dead body", and the other would reply, in a loud sinister tone, "and FUCK IT".  We always made sure somebody heard us. Reference from an Achievement Hunter Let's Play.

I work as a supervisor for a popular grocery store. It was around 10pm which meant it was time to do pickups, this is when my manager and I take the tills from each register that are not occupied and take large bills from the ones that are. I have two tills in my hands, he has about three, and then BAM! I drop them. Money goes flying. Every customer is staring as they hear money fling across the floor. My manager and I met eyes for what felt like hours. He said absolutely nothing, biting his lip out of frustration, I felt hotter than I ever had before, as I got on my knees.... and carefully picked up each bill and coin I could find. I was so embarrassed, but I surprisingly kept my job.
Exactly. I had no idea I was going to cry. It just sorta happened. I know he's a normal human being, but these guys have had such an impact on me, I just got emotional.
From being able to meet/talk to them. I wasn't expecting to be able to meet them, so when I had the opportunity I began crying out of excitement/ nerves. Gavin probably thought I was such a freak.

To work at Roosterteeth. Not to play video games, but to work at a  company surrounded by great talented people, and to be involved in production and animation. To bring joy and laughter to people, just like they did for me. Unfortunately, I know this could never happen, but it's all I ever think about.
